repos_data.description: PDF extraction that audits its own output — and certifies any other extractor's, catching pages they silently dropped. Verify signed manifests offline: free, MIT, no account. 0.903 on opendataloader-bench, #2 of 8 engines. 7-tool MCP server.
A PDF reader, CLI and MCP server that run on your computer: tables, charts, headings and scans to Markdown, HTML or JSON.
